description: Always-on, local-first AI agent desktop app — bring your own API key, any provider.
name: open-bot

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@open-bot/core && npm run build --workspace=@open-bot/tools && npm run build --workspace=@open-bot/desktop && npm run build --workspace=@open-bot/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@open-bot/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@open-bot/tools && npm run typecheck --workspace=@open-bot/desktop && npm run typecheck --workspace=@open-bot/cli
scripts.release:mac: node scripts/release-preflight.mjs mac && npm run dist:mac --workspace=@open-bot/desktop -- --publish always
scripts.release:win: node scripts/release-preflight.mjs win && npm run dist:win --workspace=@open-bot/desktop -- --publish always
scripts.release:linux: node scripts/release-preflight.mjs linux && npm run dist:linux --workspace=@open-bot/desktop -- --publish always
